additional_info.subject: ID0408782-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P8 170000834] The outlet 2 of this charger is unavailable with an error flag on FB1 CRM:00641001140
additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
Hope you are doing well.
We have analyzed the logs based on the reported issue and observed that the RCD has tripped multiple times over the past month.
Please refer to the logs below, where we can see repeated RCD tripping.
Based on this, we recommend checking the
RCD FB1
and
MCB_FC5
, as these have been captured multiple times in the error logs.
As of now, the issue has been reset, and
Outlet 2 is available for charging
, with no persistent error flags. The decision on further action is up to you.
If you plan to investigate further, please refer to the
KA
for troubleshooting the issue. Additionally, please check the
connections
, and if the issue persists, replacement may be required.
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SiCD_HW_FB1 RCD_ AC plug not working - Dynamics 365
During the intervention, kindly carry a
spare RCD and MCB_FC5_AC
in case a replacement is needed.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Abhinav Malokar
Please do not
change
the
subject of this Email when
replying
to it.
